images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: synthetic demonstration photograph for a four-step event check-in desk preparation guide. Create ONE realistic documentary photograph, NOT a collage, showing a small volunteer-run indoor event registration desk with no people, no logos, no personal data, no watermark. Wide horizontal composition, camera looking down at about 40 degrees so the whole light oak rectangular table is visible, plain softly lit off-white conference room behind. All objects clear, natural and physically plausible. Consistent layout that later close-up photographs can preserve: at REAR LEFT of the table one upright white acrylic sign with only the exact large black text 'CHECK-IN'; along MIDDLE CENTER of table two shallow open plastic badge trays side by side, BLUE tray on the LEFT holding six stacked blank white name badge cards with blue lanyards, YELLOW tray on the RIGHT holding six stacked blank white name badge cards with yellow lanyards. Keep a visible empty hand-width gap between the two trays. At FRONT RIGHT one gray clipboard with a blank white paper sheet with simple faint unfilled horizontal rows, and two ordinary ballpoint pens laid separately beside it: one solid BLACK pen and one solid BLUE pen, easy to distinguish and fully visible. Pens have NO brand names or printed writing. Front left edge of the table is empty as a visitor standing space. No extra objects, no laptop, no cups, no phone, no fabric lanyards tangled between trays, no business branding or real names. Photo should be practical and candid, sharp enough for a vision model to locate the sign, both trays, both pens and clipboard. Do not add any image annotations, boxes, numbers, or labels except the printed CHECK-IN on the sign. Landscape 3:2 composition.
